Build the Vaccination Rate Array

Source: R/vaccination_inputs.R
build_vaccination_rates.Rd

Converts routine coverage by dose and supplementary immunisation activity (SIA) coverage into the daily vaccination probabilities the model uses, indexed by age group, the stratum people are vaccinated out of, risk group and year.

Usage

build_vaccination_rates(
  routine_coverage,
  dose_ages,
  sia,
  years,
  n_vacc,
  population,
  aggregate_age,
  new_age_breaks,
  coverage_accuracy = 1
)

Arguments

routine_coverage

Matrix from [routine_dose_coverage()].

dose_ages

Matrix from [routine_dose_ages()].

sia

Data frame of SIA coverage with columns `year`, `age` (single years) and `coverage` (proportion), or `NULL`.

years

Model years.

n_vacc

Number of vaccination strata.

population

Matrix of population by year (rows) and single year of age (columns, 0 to 100).

aggregate_age, new_age_breaks

Age structure of the model.

coverage_accuracy

Multiplier on the odds of vaccination.

Value

A data frame with columns `dim1` (age group), `dim2` (stratum left), `dim3`, `dim4` (year index), `year` and `value` (daily probability), holding non-zero entries only.

Details

Routine doses are given in the model age group that contains the scheduled age, at the rate that makes the share vaccinated on leaving that group equal to the reported coverage (see [coverage_to_daily_rate()]). Dose 1 moves people out of the unvaccinated stratum. Dose `d > 1` moves people out of both strata of dose `d - 1`, at the rate that reproduces the coverage of dose `d` among those who have had dose `d - 1`.

An SIA is applied in its year at the rate that reaches its coverage within the year, in every stratum that can still receive a dose. Its coverage by single year of age is averaged over the model age group, weighted by population, before it is converted to a rate.
